youtube.title: Your RAM might run slower than you paid for 🐌 #shorts
youtube.description:
Check: Ctrl + Shift + Esc → Performance → Memory → Speed. Bought 3200 but it says 2133? XMP (Intel) / EXPO (AMD) is off. Turn it on in your BIOS – check your motherboard manual first.

More free tools: https://slimbitapps.github.io/

#pcgaming #gamingpc #pctips
